assignment: Re-prove the D243(a)-falsifying fact before Decide amends the ledger: pinned vercel CLI version, existence + surface of `vercel sandbox config network-policy`, vendored dist mechanism (sandbox.update on an existing sandbox), and whether the cloud-sandbox-runner.mjs reuse branch is still untouched since D243
verdict: FACT RE-PROVEN, HOLDS — D243(a)'s 'no Vercel API to narrow a live sandbox's allowlist without a fresh create' is FALSE and should be struck/amended. `vercel sandbox config network-policy <name>` exists on the pinned 54.13.0 CLI, exposes exactly --allowed-domain/--allowed-cidr/--denied-cidr/--network-policy/--mode, resolves the sandbox BY NAME via sandboxClient.get(...) and calls sandbox.update({ networkPolicy }) on that EXISTING sandbox object (dist/app-BPs0T7SC.mjs:15738-15749) — no fresh create involved. D243(b) (enforcement is live-only) and D243(c) (self-heals credential-less) are untouched by this fact and still stand. The cloud-sandbox-runner.mjs reuse-skip-create branch is confirmed untouched since D243 (last touch was #4184, W29/D237-D242, before D243) — the one commit on the file since D243 (#5552, W30 sanitize belt) only rewrote error-message construction at 3 unrelated call sites, never the reuse branch.

reasoning: D243(a) as ledgered claims 'no Vercel API to narrow a live sandbox's allowlist without a fresh create.' That premise is refuted directly: `vercel sandbox config network-policy <name>` is a first-class subcommand on the exact pinned CLI (54.13.0, confirmed on PATH, not drifted), and its vendored handler in dist/app-BPs0T7SC.mjs resolves the target sandbox by name through sandboxClient.get(...) — the SAME lookup-by-name pattern the runner's own reuse branch would need — then mutates it in place via sandbox.update({ networkPolicy }). No create, no snapshot, no destruction of the /tmp+transcript state D243(a) worried a narrowing-fix would cost. This does NOT resurrect D243 as a whole: (b) enforcement is still live-only (no offline test can prove a stale allowlist causes real egress without a live sandbox) and (c) the credential-less self-heal still stands (cloud_policy.ex re-derives both the MCP entry and the egress host set from the CURRENT installed set every turn) — neither was examined or touched by this fact, only (a)'s API-existence claim. The correct Decide action is a targeted amendment striking/rewording (a)'s 'no API exists' language while leaving p4/open and the live-gate re-escalation intact, exactly as the digest specified — not a build this wave, since the reuse branch that would consume this API is confirmed byte-identical since before D243 and the live stop/resume + propagation semantics needed to actually wire it up are deliberately out of Arm B's offline scope.
